# Quest Journal

Quest Journal presents a vault as an RPG quest journal, pairing a warm parchment light mode with an ancient-leather dark mode, tactile paper grain and a centered, book-style layout. Ornate headers, bookmark-like tabs, ink-style checkboxes and serif typography carry the look, and colors, textures and fonts are adjustable through Style Settings.

![Quest Journal screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackers228/quest-journal-theme/HEAD/questjournal.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Quest Journal"
    author: "jackers228"
    repo:   "jackers228/quest-journal-theme"
    slug:   "quest-journal"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/quest-journal"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jackers228/quest-journal-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackers228/quest-journal-theme/HEAD/questjournal.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Transform your Obsidian vault into a quest journal with warm parchment light and ancient-leather dark modes, tactile paper grain, and a centered, book-style layout. Use ornate headers, bookmark-like tabs, ink-style checkboxes, and readable serif typography for an RPG-ready, story-driven workspace. Customize colors, textures, and fonts via Style Settings."
}
```
